Strong visual match! Leaf_Mold reference shows a leaf on the same type of surface with similar yellow patches. Let me continue checking other candidates.

| Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus | No — bronzing + discrete necrotic spots |

**Conclusion:** The Leaf_Mold reference (CDDM_1006.jpg) is nearly identical to the test image — same sandy background, leaf lying flat, mostly green with pale yellow patches on the upper surface consistent with early Leaf_Mold chlorosis. No other class comes close visually.
